stops.stop: Paris, the Cercle Proudhon founded without him

That article also records Sorel as hostile to the Circle from the start, fearing it would make young men less able to understand Proudhon. Historians dispute how sincere and how sustained that hostility was, and a gathering pass wrongly reported it as a later disavowal; the dispute is not resolved here.
